added_claim_errors: Attributes the quoted wording '另外支付'不低于300%……一般不安排补休 to 劳部发〔1997〕271号第4条; from my own knowledge that wording is in item 3 of the 复函 (item 4 covers comprehensive hours and holiday pay under 劳动法44(3)). Small misattribution. I tried the cited link but could not open it (certificate error on the IP-address host).

Table shows '413.79 × 300% × 3 = 3,724.14' and '413.79 × 200% × 4 = 3,310.34'. With the rounded 413.79 these come to 3,724.11 and 3,310.32. The shown totals come from the unrounded rate, so this is a cosmetic mismatch of a few fen, not an error.

Scenario B: '按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元' and '有审批时这7天大约在3,724～6,207元之间'. The key says the 150% amount cannot be computed from the facts given. The arithmetic is right (9000/21.75/8×1.5×32 = 2,482.76), and B does add '若周期内总工时没超就是0'. Still, comprehensive-hours overtime is counted over the whole period and cannot be tied to these days, so the range is speculative.
Calls the Fengtai court article '北京丰台法院2026年的案例解读'. The link is given, but I could not verify the 2026 date.

reasons: Both answers reject the premise up front and reach the right totals: 3,724.14 + 3,310.34 = 7,034.48 on top of the 9,000 salary. Both say holidays stay at 300% even with an approval, and both explain that comp time can replace the 200% for rest days but not for holidays. A cites the stronger set of sources (劳动法39条, 京劳社资发〔2003〕157号, the 北京人社局 2019 case, 人社部发〔2025〕2号 for 21.75). However, it leaves out 劳动合同法第26条 and does not say arbitration is free. B covers those, plus the Saturday 10/3 point and the limitation period. But B gives no basis for 21.75, and it estimates a 150% amount for scenario B, which the key lists as a deduction. Neither answer says the make-up workdays (9/20, 10/10) are ordinary workdays. On balance A is slightly ahead because it avoids the speculative scenario-B figure; its one flaw is a minor citation slip.
